---
title: "Geospatial diversity workflows"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  fig.width = 7,
  fig.height = 4.5,
  dpi = 150,
  out.width = "100%"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(tidydiversity)
```

tidydiversity keeps the whole spatial biodiversity workflow in one tidy
pipeline: sites become `sf` tables, rasters join as columns, occurrence
records are cleaned without leaving the package, distances feed
`beta_decay()`, Hill numbers map with ggplot2, and Moran's I diagnoses
spatial autocorrelation.

## Sites and rasters

```{r sites}
sites <- tibble::tibble(
  site = c("MW0200", "MW0700", "MW1200", "MW1700", "MW2200"),
  lon = c(145.23, 145.18, 145.12, 145.06, 145.01),
  lat = c(-5.72, -5.74, -5.78, -5.81, -5.85),
  elevation = c(200, 700, 1200, 1700, 2200)
)
sf_sites <- geo_as_sf(sites, lon, lat, site = site)
sf_sites
```

```{r extract, eval = requireNamespace("terra", quietly = TRUE)}
# Demo raster in place of CHELSA / WorldClim / SRTM
r <- terra::rast(
  ncols = 40, nrows = 40,
  xmin = 144.8, xmax = 145.5, ymin = -6.0, ymax = -5.5,
  crs = "EPSG:4326"
)
terra::values(r) <- sites$elevation[1] +
  800 * (terra::yFromCell(r, seq_len(terra::ncell(r))) + 6)
names(r) <- "elev_proxy"
sites_x <- geo_extract(sites, r, lon, lat)
sites_x
```

## Clean occurrence records

```{r clean}
occ <- tibble::tibble(
  species = c("Camponotus_sp1", "Camponotus_sp1", "Polyrhachis_sp2",
              "Pheidole_sp3", "ghost"),
  lon = c(145.23, 145.23, 145.12, 0, 12.58),
  lat = c(-5.72, -5.72, -5.78, 0, 55.67)
)
geo_clean(occ, lon, lat, species = species, value = "flagged")[
  c("species", "lon", "lat", ".zer", ".gbf", ".dpl", ".summary")
]
```

`geo_gbif()` accepts a pre-downloaded GBIF table (or downloads with
**rgbif** when installed) and pipes into the same cleaner.

## Distance decay without leaving the package

```{r decay}
com <- dplyr::left_join(
  png_ants,
  sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")],
  by = "site"
)
decay_geo <- geo_decay(com, lon, lat, .by = season, method = "haversine")
decay_elev <- geo_decay(
  com, elevation = elevation, .by = season, method = "elevation"
)
head(decay_geo)
```

```{r decay-plot, eval = requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)}
ggplot2::autoplot(decay_geo) + ggplot2::labs(title = "Geographic distance decay")
```

## Map Hill numbers

```{r map, eval = requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)}
est <- div_estimate(png_ants, q = 0, nboot = 0, .by = season)
est <- dplyr::left_join(est, sites[c("site", "lon", "lat")], by = "site")
est_dry <- est[est$season == "dry", ]
plot_geo(est_dry, estimate, lon, lat, label = site) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Observed richness of PNG ants (dry season)")
```

## Spatial autocorrelation

```{r moran}
set.seed(1)
g <- expand.grid(x = 1:8, y = 1:8)
g$richness <- g$x + g$y + 0.05 * stats::rnorm(nrow(g))
geo_moran(g, richness, lon = x, lat = y, nperm = 199, correlogram = TRUE)
```
